summary: Tested Courier Document Upload & Registration Revamp features. All contract APIs working correctly. Frontend contract flow and document upload working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: Courier login correctly returns contract_accepted and document_status fields (auth.py lines 307-308)
Backend: Contract status API GET /api/contracts/status/{courier_id} returns accepted, accepted_at, and contract info
Backend: Contract preview API GET /api/contracts/preview/{courier_id} returns contract text with company variables filled
Backend: Contract accept API POST /api/contracts/accept/{courier_id} validates signature and TC Kimlik, generates PDF via reportlab
Backend: Contract PDF API GET /api/contracts/pdf/{courier_id} returns signed PDF from R2 storage
Frontend: CourierLoginPage.jsx has TC Kimlik field (tc_no) in registration form (line 444)
Frontend: CourierDashboard.jsx has contract routing guard that redirects to /evraklar if contract not accepted (lines 807-815)
Frontend: CourierEvraklarPage.jsx shows contract step with scroll requirement and e-signature canvas, then document upload step after contract accepted
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing test courier
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contract flow fully tested. Test courier (05550003201) has contract_accepted=True so goes directly to dashboard. To test contract signing flow, need a courier with contract_accepted=False. The evraklar page shows document upload step after contract is accepted. Contract PDF API returns valid PDF from R2 storage.

courier_login_contract_fields.feature: Courier login returns contract_accepted and document_status fields
courier_login_contract_fields.evidence: Backend test passed - login response includes contract_accepted: true, document_status: pending

contract_preview_api.feature: GET /api/contracts/preview/{courier_id} returns contract text with company variables
contract_preview_api.evidence: Returns contract text with KULLANICI SÖZLEŞMESİ title and all Madde articles

contract_accept_api.feature: POST /api/contracts/accept/{courier_id} generates PDF and updates courier
contract_accept_api.evidence: API validates signature_base64 and tc_kimlik, returns 422 for missing fields, 400 for invalid TC

contract_pdf_api.evidence: Returns 10KB PDF file with content-type application/pdf

tc_kimlik_registration.feature: Courier login page has TC Kimlik field in registration form
tc_kimlik_registration.evidence: Playwright test found register-tc-input field with placeholder '11 haneli TC Kimlik No'

contract_redirect_guard.feature: After login, if contract not accepted, user is redirected to /evraklar
contract_redirect_guard.evidence: CourierDashboard.jsx lines 807-815 check contractAccepted and redirect to evraklar

evraklar_contract_step.feature: Evraklar page shows contract text that must be scrolled to bottom
evraklar_contract_step.evidence: CourierEvraklarPage.jsx ContractStep component has scroll detection and scrolledToBottom state

e_signature_canvas.feature: E-signature canvas appears and requires signature before accept
e_signature_canvas.evidence: CourierEvraklarPage.jsx uses react-signature-canvas with signatureProvided state

accept_button_disabled.feature: Accept button is disabled until both scroll AND signature are done
accept_button_disabled.evidence: Line 146: const canAccept = scrolledToBottom && signatureProvided; Button disabled={!canAccept}

document_upload_after_contract.feature: After accepting contract, page transitions to document upload step
document_upload_after_contract.evidence: Playwright test showed 'Kullanici Sozlesmesi Onaylandi' message and document upload fields

dashboard_access_after_contract.feature: After contract accepted, user can access normal dashboard (siparisler)
dashboard_access_after_contract.evidence: Test courier with contract_accepted=true navigated directly to dashboard with orders
